limits: Exact stress-intensity relation within the stated infinite-plate LEFM idealization; it is not K_Ic, a fracture criterion, a material strength bound or an allowable.
K_I has dimension pressure times square root of length and SI unit Pa*m^0.5; it is not bulk modulus K or a stress in Pa.
a is half of total crack length 2a. Finite width, edge/surface cracks, significant yielding, crack interactions, residual stress, mixed-mode and dynamic loading require other descriptions.
The source figure indicates 2a much smaller than plate width W. No unreported finite-width accuracy threshold is inferred.
No composite modulus, toughness, critical fracture energy or failure stress is inferred by this relation.
Unknown or violated premises do not justify applying this formula. A catalog query returns definitions, not numerical results or specimen applicability states.

parameters.meaning: Uniform remote tensile stress normal to the crack; use gross far-field stress, not net-ligament stress.
Positive crack half-length; the complete central through crack is 2*a, not a. Continuum crack scale is required.
